links.outcome: Provider alert burden and resolution from AI-supported PA-pressure threshold alerts
links.effect: 53 provider alerts (0.88/patient-month), all resolved (median 24 h), no overrides; 17 of 19 per-protocol patients (89%) needed no escalation.
links.quote: TIR-PAP was 88.4% (ITT)/91.3% (PP); reading adherence 92.1%; 53 provider alerts (0.88/patient-month) all resolved (median 24 h) with no overrides.
